features: Train-only longest lexeme up to4Han, typed role sequences2..4, subject/action, negation/action, classifier/noun category/head, action/object category/head, question/action and shared subject/negative/action/object categories. At most12 trailing Han context and6token history; each feature<=2. Complete sentences and evaluation POS never become features.
runtime: Optional PRR1 positive residual max(0,strength*clip(candidateRaw-originalRaw,+-2)-0.1) over frozen original candidate pools/scores. Original structural first pin is retained except a higher adjusted-scoring candidate with lift>=0.5 and at least2 positive trained lexical-relation kinds can override by>=0.25. Explicit known-word/sequence/context confirmations remain protected. No raw confidence, beam, dictionary or learning-schema change.
selection: Fresh written100 and source-disjoint UD film validation plus known660. Require no per-set first/top5/top20 loss; select equal-set MRR, tie lower strength. Intersect original regression eligibility before opening new heldout. Disable if ineffective or unsafe. Cases missing from original pool are never invented.
independent_test: Frozen fresh written500 and source-disjoint UD parliament examples opened only after decision/guards. Previous800 and all older cases are regression material. No outcome-driven changes after opening reserve.
delivery: Only independently useful first/top5 improvement with neither worse and passing existing regression, Single learning and quiet paired desktop latency<=1.2 can enable production asset. 1.0 requires original+5percentage-point head/top5 gates and physical Fold7 evidence; no APK on merely synthetic/calibration gains.

semantic_categories: Conservative exact project-authored noun groups, unknown nouns generic. Do not infer food/person/equipment from a shared last character; this prevents e.g. 錢包,花生,司機 category mistakes. Lexical head relation features remain learned evidence.
